items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The clothing and jewellery are also excluded under §4.3(d)–(f) as personal effects kept in a vehicle away from the insured location, so the payable threshold is €0.
The car is excluded under §4.3(e), and §5.2.5 expressly excludes vehicle and journey costs. The payable threshold is €0; the conditional estimate uses the gross prior of €78 for one invoiced unit.
